76600.meaning1: quick higher ordination; (comm) was one's ordination
76600.commentary: (THa) sā me ās'ūpasampadā'ti yā maṃ uddissa ehi, bhaddā'ti satthu vācā pavattā, sā eva me mayhaṃ upasampadā āsi. (THa) ās'ūpasampadā'ti ehi, bhikkhū'ti satthu vacanamattena āsi upasampadā. (THIa) ehi, bhadde'ti maṃ avaca, sā me ās'ūpasampadā'ti yaṃ maṃ bhagavā arahattaṃ patvā pabbajjañ'ca upasampadañ'ca yācitvā ṭhitaṃ ehi, bhadde, bhikkhun'upassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ santike pabbaja upasampajjassū'ti avaca āṇāpesi. sā satthu āṇā mayhaṃ upasampadāya kāraṇattā upasampadā āsi ahosi.
76600.notes: The commentary takes it is āsi, aorist of atthi, but the fact that it is always used in the context of ehi bhikkhu, i.e. an instant ordination, strongly suggests the adverb.

examples.text: tato satthā nirākatvā, paṭisallānavuṭṭhito, ehi bhaddā'ti maṃ āha, sā me ās'ūpasampadā.
disvā pāsādachāyāyaṃ, caṅkamantaṃ nar'uttamaṃ, tattha naṃ upasaṅkamma, vandissaṃ puris'uttamaṃ.

76602.commentary: (APAa) jātiyā sattavasso'ti mātugabbhato nikkhantakālato paṭṭhāya paripuṇṇasattavassiko'ti attho.

examples.text: jātiyā sattavasso'haṃ, laddhāna upasampadaṃ, dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ, aho dhammasudhammatā'ti.
na mayhaṃ kappate ajja, sare hatthehi bhañjituṃ, sikkhāpadā no paññattā, gotamena yasassinā.

76604.meaning1: name of a Brahman in the time of Revata Buddha; previous incarnation of the Buddha

76606.commentary: (ANa) lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo'ti ubbedhena rasso, nāmena bhaddiyo. (UDa) lakuṇḍakabhaddiyan'ti ettha bhaddiyo'ti tassa āyasmato nāmaṃ, kāyassa pana rassattā lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo'ti naṃ sañjānanti. so kira sāvatthivāsī kulaputto mahaddhano mahābhogo rūpena apāsādiko dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako. so ekadivasaṃ satthari jetavane viharante upāsakehi saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gantvā dhammadesanaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā laddh'ūpasampado satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karonto sot'āpattiphalaṃ pāpuṇi. tadā sekkhā bhikkhū yebhuyyena āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ upasaṅkamitvā uparimagg'atthāya kammaṭṭhānaṃ yācanti, dhammadesanaṃ yācanti, pañhaṃ pucchanti. (THa) atirassatāya pana lakuṇḍakabhaddiyo'ti paññāyittha. so satthu santike dhammaṃ sutvā, paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā, bahussuto dhammakathiko hutvā madhurena sarena paresaṃ dhammaṃ kathesi. athekasmiṃ ussavadivase ekena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ rathena gacchantī aññatarā gaṇikā theraṃ disvā dantavidaṃsakaṃ hasi. thero tassā dantaṭṭhike nimittaṃ gahetvā jhānaṃ uppādetvā, taṃ pādakaṃ katvā, vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā, anāgāmī ahosi.
76606.notes: Theragāthā verses 466-472 (TH7.2, TH225) are attributed to him.

examples.text: sundarasamuddo thero, thero lakuṇḍabhaddiyo, bhaddo thero ca sopāko, sarabhaṅgo mahā-isi, sattake pañcakā therā, gāthāyo pañcatiṃsatī'ti.
sundarasamuddo thero, thero lakuṇḍabhaddiyo, bhaddo thero ca sopāko, sarabhaṅgo mahā-isi, sattake pañcakā therā, gāthāyo pañcatiṃsatī'ti.
paṅko'ti hi naṃ avedayuṃ, y'āyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu, sukhumaṃ sallaṃ durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho.

76609.meaning1: as one knew; how one knew
76609.commentary: (THa) attā ca naṃ yathā vedī'ti naṃ sattaṃ tassa attā cittaṃ yathā ahaṃ parisuddho, aparisuddho vā'ti yāthāvato avedi jānāti.

examples.text: na pare vacanā coro, na pare vacanā muni, attā ca naṃ yathāvedi, devā'pi naṃ tathā vidū.

76610.meaning1: loss of possessions; depletion of wealth; financial ruin
76610.commentary: (THa) tathā akaronto'pi jīvate vā'pi sappañño, api vittaparikkhayo parikkhīṇadhano'pi sappaññajātiko itar'ītarasantosena santuṭṭho anavajjāya jīvikāya jīvati'y'eva.

examples.text: jīvate vā'pi sappañño, api vittaparikkhayo, paññāya ca alābhena, vittavā'pi na jīvati.

76611.synonym: aḍḍha, aḍḍhī, adalidda, adaḷidda, dhana, dhanavant, bhogavant, bhogī, mahaddhana, sadhana

examples.text: jīvate vā'pi sappañño, api vittaparikkhayo, paññāya ca alābhena, vittavā'pi na jīvati.

76612.meaning1: to discard; to dump; to abandon; to leave; to forsake
76612.commentary: (THa) na ca diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ dhīro, sabbaṃ ujjhitun'ti ca nidassanamattam'etaṃ. yañ'hi taṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ vā, na taṃ sabbaṃ dhīro sappañño ujjhituṃ pariccajituṃ gahetuṃ vā arahati. guṇ'āguṇaṃ pana tattha upaparikkhitvā ujjhitabbam'eva ujjhituṃ gahetabbañ'ca gahetuṃ arahati

examples.text: sabbaṃ suṇāti sotena, sabbaṃ passati cakkhunā, na ca diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ dhīro, sabbaṃ ujjhitum'arahati.

76613.meaning1: sleeping like a corpse; lying like the dead
76613.commentary: (THa) atha atthe samuppanne, sayetha matasāyikan'ti attanā kātabbakicce uppanne upaṭṭhite matasāyikaṃ sayetha, matasāyikaṃ sayitvā'pi taṃ kiccaṃ tīretabbam'eva, na virādhetabbaṃ. atha vā atha atthe samuppanne'ti attanā akaraṇīye atthe kicce uppanne upaṭṭhite matasāyikaṃ sayetha, matasāyikaṃ sayitvā'pi taṃ na kātabbam'eva. na hi paṇḍito ayuttaṃ kātum'arahatī'ti evaṃ therena ovadito rājā akattabbaṃ pahāya kātabbe'y'eva yuttappayutto ahosī'ti. (JAa) yaṃ sesi matasāyikan'ti yena kāraṇena tvaṃ matasāyikaṃ sesi, matako viya hutvā sayasi.

examples.text: cakkhumā'ssa yathā andho, sotavā badhiro yathā, paññavā'ssa yathā mūgo, balavā dubbalo'r'iva, atha atthe samuppanne, sayetha matasāyikan'ti.

76614.commentary: (THa) chaḍḍayin'ti, pajahiṃ. chaḍḍiyan'ti'pi pāṭho. nanu ayaṃ thero dārapariggahaṃ akatvā'va pabbajito, so kasmā puttadārañ'ca chaḍḍayin'ti avocā'ti? yathā nāma puriso anibbattaphalam'eva rukkhaṃ chindanto acchinne tato laddhaphalehi parihīno nāma hoti. evaṃsampadam'idaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

examples.text: tad'āhaṃ puttadārañ'ca, dhanadhaññañ'ca chaḍḍayiṃ, kesamassūni chedetvā, pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ.

76615.meaning1: undertaken the training and lifestyle; engaged in the precepts and practice (of)

examples.text: sikkhāsājīvasampanno, indriyesu susaṃvuto, namassamāno sambuddhaṃ, vihāsiṃ aparājito.

76616.commentary: (THa) tato paṭṭhāya devamanussesu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde magadharaṭṭhe ibbhakule nibbatto gosālo nāma nāmena. soṇena pana koṭikaṇṇena kataparicayattā tassa pabbajitabhāvaṃ sutvā so'pi nāma mahāvibhavo pabbajissati, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhan'ti sañjātasaṃvego bhagavato santike pabbajitvā cariy'ānukūlaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā sappāyaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gavesanto attano jātagāmassa avidūre ekasmiṃ sānupabbate vihāsi. tassa mātā divase divase bhikkhaṃ deti. ath'ekadivasaṃ gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhassa mātā madhusakkhar'ābhisaṅkhataṃ pāyāsaṃ adāsi.
76616.notes: Theragāthā verse 23 (TH1.23, TH23) is attributed to him.

76624.commentary: (THa) papañca-saṅghāta-dukh'ādhivāhinin'ti sattasantānaṃ saṃsāre papañcenti vitthārentī'ti papañcā, rāg'ādayo mān'ādayo ca. te eva pavattidukkhassa saṅghāt'aṭṭhena saṅghātā, sadarathapariḷāhasabhāvattā dukkhañ'cā'ti papañca-saṅghāta-dukhaṃ, tassa adhivāhato nibbattanato papañca-saṅghāta-dukh'ādhivāhinī.

dasasu lokadhātūsu, sannipatitvāna devatā, payirupāsanti sambuddhaṃ, vasantaṃ nagamuddhani.

76660.commentary: (THa) guṇasobhena paramasugandhā vimutti'y'eva kusumāni, tehi sabbaso samma'd'eva sañchanno vibhūsito alaṅ'kato'ti vimuttikusumasañchanno

examples.text: sammappadhānasampanno, satipaṭṭhānagocaro, vimuttikusumasañchanno, parinibbissaty'anāsavo'ti.
vane kusumasañchanne, pabbhāre nūna sītale, vimuttisukhena sukhito, ramissāmi giribbaje.

76661.synonym: appiya, amitta, ari, diṭṭha, disa, sapatta

examples.text: anāgataṃ yo paṭikacca passati, hitañ'ca atthaṃ ahitañ'ca taṃ dvayaṃ, viddesino tassa hit'esino vā, randhaṃ na passanti samekkhamānā.
anāgataṃ yo paṭikacca passati, hitañ'ca atthaṃ ahitañ'ca taṃ dvayaṃ, viddesino tassa hit'esino vā, randhaṃ na passanti samekkhamānā.

76663.meaning1: mindfulness while breathing in and out; mindfulness during inhalation and exhalation
76663.commentary: (THa) idāni ān'āpānasatibhāvanāya guṇaṃ dassento tattha tāni yojetuṃ ān'āpānasatī yassā'ti dutiyaṃ gātham'āha. ānan'ti assāso. apānan'ti passāso. assāsapassāsanimitt'ārammaṇā sati ān'āpānasati.

examples.text: ān'āpānasatī yassa, paripuṇṇā subhāvitā, anupubbaṃ paricitā, yathā buddhena desitā, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.

76664.meaning1: raised above; lifted up; stretched out
76664.commentary: (THa) sakalasaṃkilesapakkhato paggahitañ'ca hutvā dukkh'ādikā pubb'ant'ādikā ca disā obhāsate tattha vitiṇṇakaṅkhattā sabbadhammesu vigatasammohattā ca.

examples.text: odātaṃ vata me cittaṃ, appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ, nibbiddhaṃ paggahītañ'ca, sabbā obhāsate disā.

76665.meaning1: investigating what is heard; discriminating what is learned
76665.commentary: (THa) paññā sutavinicchinī'ti paññā nām'esā sutassa vinicchayinī, yathāsute sotapatham'āgate atthe ayaṃ akusalo, ayaṃ kusalo, ayaṃ sāvajjo, ayaṃ anavajjo'ti-ādinā vinicchayajananī.

examples.text: paññā sutavinicchinī, paññā kittisilokavaddhanī, paññāsahito naro idha, api dukkhesu sukhāni vindati.

76666.commentary: (THa) paññā sutavinicchinī'ti paññā nām'esā sutassa vinicchayinī, yathāsute sotapatham'āgate atthe ayaṃ akusalo, ayaṃ kusalo, ayaṃ sāvajjo, ayaṃ anavajjo'ti-ādinā vinicchayajananī.

examples.text: paññā sutavinicchinī, paññā kittisilokavaddhanī, paññāsahito naro idha, api dukkhesu sukhāni vindati.

76668.meaning1: increasing fame and renown; growing celebrity and prestige
76668.commentary: (THa) kittisilokavaddhanī'ti kittiyā sammukhā pasaṃsāya silokassa patthaṭayasabhāvassa vaddhanī, paññavato'y'eva hi kitti'ādayo viññūnaṃ pāsaṃsabhāvato.

examples.text: paññā sutavinicchinī, paññā kittisilokavaddhanī, paññāsahito naro idha, api dukkhesu sukhāni vindati.

76670.meaning1: endowed with wisdom; full of insight

examples.text: paññā sutavinicchinī, paññā kittisilokavaddhanī, paññāsahito naro idha, api dukkhesu sukhāni vindati.
navavassasahassāni, agāraṃ ajjha so vasi, cando sucando vaṭaṃso ca, tayo pāsādam'uttamā.
tulā yathā paggahitā, samadaṇḍā sudhāritā, sabbāni abhisambhonto, sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
pakk'odano'ti siddhabhatto. duddhakhīro'ti gāvo duhitvā gahitakhīro.

76674.meaning1: not incredible; not marvelous; not amazing

examples.text: n'āyaṃ ajjatano dhammo, n'acchero na'pi abbhuto, yattha jāyetha mīyetha, tattha kiṃ viya abbhutaṃ.

76675.commentary: (THa) na h'etadatthāya matassa hotī'ti yaṃ matassa jīvit'atthaṃ jīvitanimittaṃ paraporisānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ ruṇṇaṃ, etaṃ tassa matassa sattassa jīvit'atthaṃ tāva tiṭṭhatu, kassaci'pi atthāya na hoti

examples.text: na h'etadatthāya matassa hoti, yaṃ jīvit'atthaṃ paraporisānaṃ, matamhi ruṇṇaṃ na yaso na lokyaṃ, na vaṇṇitaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇehi.

76676.meaning1: useful for the life; beneficial for the livelihood (of)
76676.commentary: (THa) na h'etadatthāya matassa hotī'ti yaṃ matassa jīvit'atthaṃ jīvitanimittaṃ paraporisānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ ruṇṇaṃ, etaṃ tassa matassa sattassa jīvit'atthaṃ tāva tiṭṭhatu, kassaci'pi atthāya na hoti

examples.text: na h'etadatthāya matassa hoti, yaṃ jīvit'atthaṃ paraporisānaṃ, matamhi ruṇṇaṃ na yaso na lokyaṃ, na vaṇṇitaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇehi.
na h'etadatthāya matassa hoti, yaṃ jīvit'atthaṃ paraporisānaṃ, matamhi ruṇṇaṃ na yaso na lokyaṃ, na vaṇṇitaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇehi.

76678.commentary: (THa) na yaso na lokyaṃ yas'āvahaṃ visuddh'āvahañ'ca na hoti.

examples.text: na h'etadatthāya matassa hoti, yaṃ jīvit'atthaṃ paraporisānaṃ, matamhi ruṇṇaṃ na yaso na lokyaṃ, na vaṇṇitaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇehi.

76679.commentary: (PVa) vaṇṇabal'ūpapanno'ti rūpasampattiyā sarīrabalena ca upapanno samannāgato'ti (JAa) vaṇṇabal'ūpapanno'ti sarīravaṇṇena ca kāyabalena ca upagato.

examples.text: cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahanti tena, nihīyati vaṇṇabalaṃ matī ca, ānandino tassa disā bhavanti, hit'esino n'āssa sukhī bhavanti.

76680.synonym: tejatā, pabhāva, bala, balatā, vikkama, sahas

examples.text: tasmā hi iccheyya kule vasante, medhāvino c'eva bahussute ca, yesaṃ hi paññāvibhavena kiccaṃ, taranti nāvāya nadiṃ'va puṇṇan'ti.

76681.meaning1: power of wisdom; might of insight

examples.text: tasmā hi iccheyya kule vasante, medhāvino c'eva bahussute ca, yesaṃ hi paññāvibhavena kiccaṃ, taranti nāvāya nadiṃ'va puṇṇan'ti.
bhagavā tattha āgacchi, sīsaṃ mayhaṃ parāmasi, bāhāya maṃ gahetvāna, saṅgh'ārāmaṃ pavesayi.

76683.meaning1: completely committed; fully determined (to); intently resolved (on)
76683.commentary: (THa) etaṃ suddhaṃ adhiṭṭhehi, ekam'antaṃ svadhiṭṭhitan'ti, etaṃ suddhaṃ coḷakkhaṇḍaṃ rajoharaṇaṃ, rajoharaṇan'ti manasikārena svadhiṭṭhitaṃ katvā ekam'antaṃ ekam'ante vivitte gandhakuṭipamukhe nisinno adhiṭṭhehi tathā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ katvā pavattehi.

examples.text: anukampāya me satthā, pādāsi pādapuñchaniṃ, etaṃ suddhaṃ adhiṭṭhehi, ekam'antaṃ svadhiṭṭhitaṃ.

76684.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ekamanta

examples.text: tato me satthā pāhesi, dūtaṃ kālappavedakaṃ, paveditamhi kālamhi, vehāsā'd'upasaṅkamiṃ.
tato me satthā pāhesi, dūtaṃ kālappavedakaṃ, paveditamhi kālamhi, vehāsā'd'upasaṅkamiṃ.
vanditvā satthuno pāde, ekam'antaṃ nisīdahaṃ, nisinnaṃ maṃ viditvāna, atha satthā paṭiggahi.

76688.commentary: (THa) paṭiggaṇhittha dakkhiṇan'ti jīvakena upanītaṃ yāgukhajj'ādi-bhedaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ paṭiggahesi.

examples.text: āyāgo sabbalokassa, āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho, puññakkhettaṃ manussānaṃ, paṭigaṇhittha dakkhiṇan'ti.

76689.meaning1: of various types; of different categories

examples.text: nānākulamalasampuṇṇo, mahāukkārasambhavo, candanikaṃ'va paripakkaṃ, mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo.

76690.meaning1: filled with different kinds of dirt; full of various types of impurity

examples.text: nānākulamalasampuṇṇo, mahāukkārasambhavo, candanikaṃ'va paripakkaṃ, mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo.

76691.meaning1: producing piles of excrement; (comm) born from great excrement
76691.commentary: (THa) mahāukkārasambhavo'ti, ukkāro vuccati vaccakūpaṃ. yattakavayā mātā, tattakaṃ kālaṃ kāraparisedita-vaccakūpa-sadisatāya mātu kucchi idha mahāukkāro'ti adhippeto. so kucchi sambhavo uppattiṭṭhānaṃ etassā'ti mahāukkārasambhavo.

examples.text: nānākulamalasampuṇṇo, mahāukkārasambhavo, candanikaṃ'va paripakkaṃ, mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo.

76692.commentary: (THa) sadā dukkhatāmūlayogato asucipaggharaṇato uppādajarāmaraṇehi uddhumāyana-paripaccana-bhijjana-sabhāvattā ca mahanto gaṇḍo viyā'ti mahāgaṇḍo.

examples.text: nānākulamalasampuṇṇo, mahāukkārasambhavo, candanikaṃ'va paripakkaṃ, mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo.

76694.meaning1: swelling up; puffing up; blowing up

76695.commentary: (THa) sabbatthakam'eva dukkhavedan'ānubaddhattā gaṇḍānaṃ sahanato asucivissandanato ca mahanto vaṇo viyā'ti mahāvaṇo

examples.text: nānākulamalasampuṇṇo, mahāukkārasambhavo, candanikaṃ'va paripakkaṃ, mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo.
pubbaruhirasampuṇṇo, gūthakūpena gāḷhito, āpopaggharaṇo kāyo, sadā sandati pūtikaṃ.
